q110001.Desc: 序章异象管理局-视频：开场开车到异象管理局

SkipDesc.SourceString: 三人同乘电梯，薄荷喜欢用自己闻到的味道称呼他人，她似乎决定叫你「可可」。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The three of you rode the elevator together. Mint likes to name people by the scents she smells from them, and she has decided to call you "Coco."

q110002.Desc: 序章异象管理局-sequence：异象管理局大厅白藏三人组

SkipDesc.SourceString: 「维特海默值」——衡量目标对象背离现实浓度的数值，管理局会持续监测城市各区数值，快速做出反应。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: You learned about the "Wertheimer Index"—a value which measures a target's deviation from reality. The Bureau continuously monitors this value across the city's districts and responds rapidly.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 薄荷收容的异象意外解离，你同薄荷一起进入异象空间重新收容。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: An Anomaly contained by Mint unexpectedly breached containment, and you entered the Anomalous Realm with Mint to contain it again.

q110048.Desc: 序章照相馆-sequence：初到伊波恩蟹铃

SkipDesc.SourceString: 店里看上去没人，叫出店员似乎需要……一些特殊的方式？
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: No one seems to be in the shop. Getting the staff to come out may require… a special method?

q110051.Desc: 序章照相馆-视频：薄荷打开好客屋

SkipDesc.SourceString: 薄荷意外触发「好客屋」，众人缩小，在塔吉多的眼中变成了三只……蟑螂。努力在杀虫剂下坚持到恢复原状吧！
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Mint accidentally triggered the "Hospitable House," shrinking everyone. In Taygedo's eyes, the group looked like three cockroaches… Hold out under the insecticide until you return to normal!

q110053.Desc: 序章照相馆-sequence：战胜塔吉多，加入伊波恩

SkipDesc.SourceString: 你加入伊波恩，与店内众人相识。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: You joined Eibon and got introduced to everyone in the shop.

q110082.Desc: 序章照相馆-视频：暗房胶卷boss登场

SkipDesc.SourceString: 众人来到暗房，异象R-5791「胶卷-MANISH」现身。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Everyone arrived at the darkroom, where Anomaly R-5791, "Film - MANISH," appeared.

q110084.Desc: 序章照相馆-sequence：击败胶卷boss，拍全家福

SkipDesc.SourceString: 收容成功，作为新成员，你和大家一同拍摄了欢乐的全家福。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The containment succeeded. As the newest member, you took a cheerful family photo with everyone.

q110112.Desc: 主线月光当铺-sequence：调香师公寓捉鸟

SkipDesc.SourceString: 一只怪鸟和一只怪狗先后乱入调查并带走了一具香炉，就连埃德嘉都没能查到它们的资料。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: During the investigation, a strange bird and a strange dog burst in one after another and carried off a censer. Even Edgar could not find any information on them.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 或许是有什么缘由，早雾不顾劝阻攻击双子之一的奥托，直到弟弟弥斯墨带着失踪已久的冬司和蒲公英现身……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: For some reason, Sakiri ignored your warnings and attacked one of the twins, Otro, until the younger brother Mismo appeared with the long-missing Toshi and Dandelion…

SkipDesc.SourceString: 节外生枝，鬼郎丸当众吐出了不知何时又偷偷吞下的蒲公英项圈，让蒲公英误以为主人嘭嘭也被吃掉了……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Another complication arose: Kiroumaru suddenly spat out Dandelion's collar, which it had somehow secretly re-swallowed. This caused Dandelion to mistakenly believe its owner Boomboom had been eaten…

SkipDesc.SourceString: 紧要关头，达芙蒂尔带着嘭嘭及时赶到了众人面前……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Daffodill arrived just in time with Boomboom in tow…

q110327.Desc: 主线拍卖会-视频：西汀飞车

SkipDesc.SourceString: 确认目标持有邀请函，哈索尔出现，载上你飙车接近西汀。保证接近时长以完成邀请函替换。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: After confirming that the target has an invitation, Hathor appears and drives you speedily towards Settyn. Maintain proximity long enough to complete the invitation swap.

q110377.Desc: 主线拍卖会-sequence：出电梯见异象

q1103501.Desc: 主线拍卖会-sequence：宝可梦-对战河田

q1103541.Desc: 主线拍卖会-sequence：宝可梦-对战美人鱼

q110360.Desc: 主线拍卖会-sequence：小红帽夺走”第一枝“

SkipDesc.SourceString: 落锤瞬间，画面突然定格。在静止的时空中，一名神秘少女出现，仅用一方斯取得了拍品，径直离场。唯有你们的时停提前解除了，你发觉出了意外。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The instant the gavel fell, the scene suddenly froze. In the frozen time, a mysterious girl appeared, acquired the item with a single Fons, and swiftly vanished. Only your time resumed before the others, and you realized something had gone wrong.

q110388.Desc: 主线拍卖会-视频：宴会厅礼服Boss

SkipDesc.SourceString: 进入瑰丽宴会厅，众多共舞的异象中，神秘优雅的Ⅴ级异象「永不谢幕的阿拉克涅」登场，那便共舞一曲吧。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: You entered the Splendid Banquet Hall. Among the many dancing Anomalies, the mysterious and elegant Class V Anomaly "The Never-ending Arachne" appeared. Let the dance begin.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 击败异象，阿拉克涅迎来谢幕。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The Anomaly is defeated, and Arachne takes its final bow.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 你试图控制住桀桀熊，却被它挣脱。不好，桀桀熊似乎发生了异变。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: You try to put Teehee Bear under control, but it manages to break free. Things don't look good. Something is happening to the bear.

SkipDesc.SourceString:
战胜异化的桀桀熊，你与众人分散，在茫茫雾气中登上一艘神秘的船。
一段思绪闯入你的脑海，你无法抗拒……「一切新奇事物只是忘却」。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString:
After defeating the transformed bear, you got separated from the group. In a thick fog, you board a mysterious ferry.
A thought suddenly intrudes into your head… "Everything new is but forgotten."

SkipDesc.SourceString:
大雾散去，你进入一个奇妙的海域，岸边正进行着一场盛大的游行。
你推断这就是娜娜莉走失的异象空间，手机信号在此中断，一名神秘女子正望向你……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString:
The fog dispersed as you entered a bizarre sea, with a large procession being held by the shore.
You believe this is the Anomalous Realm Nanally got lost in. Having lost your phone signal, you find a mysterious woman looking at you…

q110580.Desc: 主线洄廊3-视频：红字阴谋

SkipDesc.SourceString: 你追赶娜娜虎，而另一边「红字」势力的计划正逐步推进，唯独「你」在意料之外。在「红字」的威胁下，达芙蒂尔抱着某种目的进入了洄廊。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: You chase after Nana Tiger. Meanwhile, the Scarlet Letter's schemes keep advancing, catching you in utter surprise. Threatened by the Scarlet Letter, Daffodill enters the Corridor of Echoes with a certain goal in mind.

q110591.Desc: 主线洄廊4-视频：巨象活化

SkipDesc.SourceString: 你察觉到莳作为洄廊的创造者也有其逃避之事。你决定打破规则，让本来只能驶向「过去」的忒修斯之舵调转方向。就由你带所有人，包括莳——离开洄廊。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: You realize that Thyme, the creator of the Corridor of Echoes, is also escaping from something. You decide to break the rules and steer the Helm of Theseus, which normally navigates to the past, into the opposite direction. You will be the one to bring everyone—including Thyme—out of the Corridor.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 「忒修斯之舵」倒转，旧日种种纷纷再现，你穿越过往，击溃了巨像，与莳直接交战。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The Helm of Theseus runs in reverse. You traveled to the past, defeated the giant statue, and faced off against Thyme.

q110593.Desc: 主线洄廊5-视频：达芙蒂尔补刀

SkipDesc.SourceString: 莳的意识体被泯除，来者竟是达芙蒂尔。莳陷入痛苦，「游梦人」纷纷消散，娜娜莉的身体也逐渐变得透明。混乱之际，「红字」众人出现，夺走了「忒修斯之舵」。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Surprisingly, Thyme's projection is nullified by Daffodill. Thyme is stricken in pain. As the Dreamwalkers disperse, Nanally's body slowly becomes transparent. Amidst the chaos, members of the Scarlet Letter appear and snatch away the Helm of Theseus.

q110504.Desc: 主线洄廊去向阳岛航行视频

q110523.Desc: 主线洄廊向阳岛航行视频返程

L110011.Desc: 白藏番外-sequence：花店偶遇白藏

SkipDesc.SourceString: 在花店门口，你偶遇了潜伏于此的E.T.D四队队长白藏，而他伪装成了……一朵花。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Outside the florist, you ran into Captain Baicang, who was lying in wait disguised as… a flower?

L110046.Desc: 白藏番外-sequence：温室花房遇见boss

SkipDesc.SourceString: 面对利用麦月仅存的语言能力吐露拒绝之意的异象，白藏上前以言语挑拨激怒——麦月的真实想法与庄园所展露出的恶意是同步的吗？
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Facing the Anomaly as it used Maiyue's last remaining voice to refute you, Baicang stepped forward and verbally provoked it. Are Maiyue's true feelings really aligned with the malice shown by the manor?

L110048.Desc: 白藏番外-视频：战胜boss，白藏手语交流

SkipDesc.SourceString: 为隔绝异象的阻挠，白藏用手语搭建了仅限麦月的沟通桥梁，在终于成功了解到麦月的真心话后，白藏便发动言灵异能，宣判了整座庄园所有植物的枯萎，带来了「秋天」。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: To cut off the Anomaly's interference, Baicang communicated in sign language so that only Maiyue could reply. After finally learning Maiyue's true feelings, Baicang activated his Incantation Esper Ability and sentenced every plant in the manor to wither, bringing "autumn" upon them.

L110109.Desc: 安魂曲番外-seq1：安魂曲出场

SkipDesc.SourceString: 塔吉多在第三台自动售卖机旁被一具迷你棺材被吓到失魂落魄，一只睡眼惺忪的小蝙蝠从棺木中出现并变成了少女的模样。从赶来的薄荷口中，你们听到了眼前少女的名字——安魂曲。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: At the third vending machine, Taygedo was scared out of his wits by a miniature coffin. A sleepy little bat emerged from it and transformed into a girl. Mint, who hurried over, told you the girl's name—Lacrimosa.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 异象的骚乱让安魂曲一直都没能好好摄入番茄酱，忍不住被售货机吸引的她刚好碰上了前来破坏的「番茄酱恶魔」。第一轮交锋中，番茄酱售卖机被意外卷入了她们的攻击……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The Anomaly's disturbance had kept Lacrimosa from getting a proper intake of tomato jelly. Unable to resist the vending machine, she happened to run into the "Tomato Devil" as it appeared to destroy it. During their clash, the ketchup vending machine was accidentally caught up in their attacks…

SkipDesc.SourceString: 「番茄酱恶魔」无路可退，最终在你和安魂曲的携手攻击下化为番茄酱消失了。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: With nowhere left to run, the "Tomato Devil" finally dissolved into a puddle of ketchup as you and Lacrimosa struck together.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 尽管看起来好像有点不知天高地厚，但两人练习的热情确实无可指摘，乐队也肉眼可见地有了进步……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Although they seemed a bit too big for their britches, there was no denying their passion for practice. The band was improving, bit by bit…

SkipDesc.SourceString: 演奏渐入佳境，但面对台下聚集的观众，哈尼娅还是因为紧张而出现了失误。所幸明音及时救场，最终帮你们顺利完成了演出。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Your performance was finding its groove, but when the audience gathered below the stage, Haniel's nerves caused her to make a mistake. Fortunately, Akane stepped in just in time to help you complete the show.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 从最初的「陪小孩过家家」到后来的沉浸其中，这段街头练习的时光让明音的心态也逐渐发生了转变。或许现在的「猫头音！！！！」真的有了足以登上「月亮狗之夜」演出的实力……
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: From first "playing along with kids" to actually becoming invested in it, the practice sessions have gradually changed Akane's mindset as well. Perhaps now THE WHOOTS!!!! really does have what it takes to perform at "Night of Moondog"…

SkipDesc.SourceString: 舞台上的明音久违地全身心投入到演出中，星空下极光般的幻景也代表了「月亮狗之夜」对你们的认可。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Onstage, Akane put her all into a performance for the first time in ages, and the aurora-like vision under the starry sky represented "Night of Moondog"'s recognition of you.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 一行人与塔可汇合，娜娜莉等人冒充手下，为塔吉多塑造「老大」人设。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: The group met up with Tako. Nanally and the others pretended to be subordinates to reinforce Taygedo's "boss" persona.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 娜娜莉和早雾扮演反派出场，声称要收拾「活在城市阴暗面的幕后老大」塔吉多。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Nanally and Sakiri disguised as villains, claiming they would deal with Taygedo, "the mastermind boss who lives in the city's shadows."

SkipDesc.SourceString: 娜娜莉二人败退，治安所赶来查看情况，众人姑且「低调隐蔽」。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Nanally and the others retreated in defeat, as the Security Office arrived to check on the situation. For the moment, everyone chose to "keep a low profile."

SkipDesc.SourceString: 塔吉多将随心泥捏成自己与塔可手牵手的形状作为表演，并准备顺势告白。此时随心泥却突然失控，胡乱攻击周遭。阿德勒及时救下塔可，你准备出手应对。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Taygedo shaped Imaginadough into a figure of himself and Tako holding hands as part of the performance, preparing to confess right after. But then Imaginadough suddenly went haywire and began to rampage. Adler saved Tako in time, and you prepared to respond.

CR_Battle_Part1.Desc: 创角之后新手战场第一段黑幕

CR_Fadia_FightEnd.Desc: 新手战场法蒂亚战斗结束黑幕

SkipDesc.SourceString: 九点整，讨债人现身，风花似乎早有期待。蕾妮被讨债人的武器贯穿，却并未有所损伤，你出手应对。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: At exactly nine, the Debt Collector appeared, and Fuuka seemed to have been expecting it. Renee was pierced by the Debt Collector's weapon but suffered no injury, and you stepped in to respond.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 富丽堂皇的大厅中，一场诡异的晚宴正在进行。神秘的女人点亮烛火，你和蕾妮似乎被她发现，宴会消散，异象出现。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: In the opulent hall, an eerie dinner party is underway. A mysterious woman lights the candles, and you and Renee seemed to be discovered by her. The banquet dispersed, and an Anomaly appeared.

SQ_WJ101301.Desc: 偶遇任务-回忆是樱花味的

SQ_WJ101401.Desc: 偶遇任务-蛋糕是薄巧味的

SQ_WJ101601.Desc: 偶遇任务-旅程是海盐味的

SQ_WJ102501.Desc: 偶遇任务-今夜月光倾斜

SQ_WJ104401.Desc: 偶遇任务-「夜空下的邀请」

q110457.Desc: 讨债人德洛莉丝创造人偶黑幕

SkipDesc.SourceString: 樱花树下，一家人欢乐相聚的旧日景象重现，「贝拉」现身揭开背后隐藏的秘密：为回应德洛莉丝的愿望，木偶作为「孩子」苏醒，然而她的愿望未能圆满，因为小女儿蕾妮为家族带来了诅咒与毁灭。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Beneath the cherry tree, a joyful scene of family reunion from the past reappeared. "Bella" revealed the secret hidden behind it: in response to Dolores's wish, the puppets awakened as her "children," but her wish was never fully fulfilled. Her youngest daughter, Renee, brought a curse and destruction upon the family.

SkipDesc.SourceString: 蕾妮深信自己是背叛者，是自己害死了家人，她在重压下精神崩溃，放弃了「恒今时」，被「残虹」夺走。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: Renee became convinced that she was the betrayer, that she had caused her family's deaths. Under the crushing weight of it, she broke down and gave up "Eternal Present," which was stolen by "Zankou."

q110489.Desc: 讨债人剧情，残虹借由讨债人的出现脱身

SkipDesc.SourceString: 在你与残虹激战正酣时，卡厄斯撕开空间现身，娜娜莉和达芙蒂尔也破墙而入。九点钟声响起，讨债人再次到来。临撤退前，残虹转向达芙蒂尔，轻轻道出「母亲」的问候。
SkipDesc.LocalizedString: While your fierce battle with Zankou was underway, Chaos tore through space and appeared alongside Nanally and Daffodill, who had also broken through. As the nine o'clock bell rang, the Debt Collector arrived again. Before retreating, Zankou turned to Daffodill and softly delivered "Mother's" greeting.

Dunner_BossBattle.Desc: 讨债人和残虹战斗的时候的氛围SEQ

SQ_WJ104601.Desc: 偶遇任务-晴转雪，宜打雪仗
